semiconductor_relevance: High — Kylinweike specializes in ultra-high purity pressure and temperature measurement instruments essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Kylinweike is a leading manufacturer of high-precision pressure and temperature measurement instruments, providing solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products, including ultra-high purity pressure gauges and transmitters, are designed to meet stringent cleanliness and purity requirements, ensuring reliable performance in gas delivery systems and chip manufacturing equipment.

regional_presence.China: Kylinweike has its production base and logistics distribution center located in Ningbo, China, along with R&D centers in Ningbo and Osaka, Japan.
regional_presence.Japan: The company has an R&D center in Osaka, Japan, focusing on advanced measurement solutions.
